name: Provolone
siboNotes: Aged hard cheeses like provolone are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated in SIBO. The aging process breaks down most lactose content.
preparationTips: Choose aged provolone over fresh varieties for lowest lactose content
Store properly wrapped in refrigerator to maintain quality
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for best flavor
Grate fresh rather than buying pre-shredded for better melting
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
